incoming.name: Africa
incoming.excerpt: Africa is the oldest inhabited territory on earth, with the human species originating from the continent.

incoming.name: Sub-Saharan Africa
incoming.excerpt: Mitochondrial Eve, from whom all humans alive are descended, is thought to have lived in present day Ethiopia or Tanzania.

outgoing.name: Ethiopia
outgoing.excerpt: The holder of this title is believed by some to have lived about 150,000 years ago in what is now Ethiopia, Kenya or Tanzania.

outgoing.name: Fossil
outgoing.excerpt: Mitochondrial Eve is sometimes referred to as African Eve, an ancestor who has been hypothesized on the grounds of fossil as well as DNA evidence.
